invariants.rationale: The method operates on 'layer', and it must be non-null to reach this point.
Method immediately returns if 'layer' is not visible, so any further execution implies it is visible.
To execute the group-layer branch, childLayers is accessed, which must not be null.
A MapLayers object should have a non-negative size, as used in the 'for' loop.
Tile layers passed to renderTileLayer must also be visible, implied by the initial visible check.
